<header class="research-header">
<h1>Research</h1>
<p class="research-intro">My research develops and applies methods in <span class="research-accent">causal inference</span>, <span class="research-accent">decision modeling</span>, and <span class="research-accent">reinforcement learning</span> to generate and synthesize evidence for better decision-making in health and public policy. I study the impacts of <span class="research-accent">physician behavior</span>, <span class="research-accent">health policies</span>, and <span class="research-accent">personalized medicine</span>.</p>
</header>
